legacy::make_iterator!();
fn main() {
    let data = [11, 13, 17];
    let table = legacy::Table::new(&data);
    let mut entries = table.enumerate();
    let mut values = table.values();
    let callback = table.callback(&data[2]);
    drop(table);
    assert_eq!(entries.next(), Some((0, &11)));
    assert_eq!(entries.next(), Some((1, &13)));
    assert_eq!(entries.next(), Some((2, &17)));
    assert_eq!(entries.next(), None);
    assert_eq!(values.next(), Some(11));
    assert_eq!(values.next(), Some(13));
    assert_eq!(values.next(), Some(17));
    assert_eq!(callback(), 17);
    let key = String::from("capture");
    let compare = legacy::equivalent(&key);
    assert!(compare(&String::from("capture")));
    assert!(!compare(&String::from("other")));
    let array = legacy::const_array::<4>();
    assert_eq!(array.as_ref(), &[3u8; 4]);
    assert_eq!(iterator(&data).copied().sum::<u32>(), 41);
    println!("rpit 3 41 {} {}", callback(), array.as_ref().len());
}
